verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single homepage marketing claim that Loops lets you 'see which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue.' That suggests some email-to-revenue attribution, but nothing explains how it works, how deep it goes, or whether signups and workflows (flows) are covered. missing for 10: documented attribution mechanics (conversion event or revenue mapping), signup attribution, per-workflow/flow-level attribution reporting, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
